title: Read basic Scheme bindings
description: This short Scheme session binds a list and values, then applies list and arithmetic functions.

steps.description: L binds to a quoted list containing the symbols a, b, and c.
car selects the first element of L. cdr selects the rest of the list.
x binds to the result of adding 3 and 2, then the next expression adds 5 to that value.

steps.question: What does add name after this definition?
steps.answer: It names the addition function +, so calling add with 3 and 2 produces 5.

steps.description: The final binding gives + another name and applies it as a value.
